title: 第2358章 青儿消息云柔见解第2357章 虫群欲来三域联盟
content_zh:
一旁的牛三古听得心头焦灼，见帝君依旧神色从容、云淡风轻，不由得满脸茫然，心底满是不解。
在他眼中，此刻已然是火烧眉毛的灭境危局！
昔日仅有昆邪山四大异族作乱，便足以搅得整座青龙域人族动荡不安，连年征战、死伤无数。
如今却是北山、火、木三大疆域的顶尖霸主联手来犯，联军之强盛、战力之恐怖，绝非昔日异族之乱可比。
这般滔天大敌压境，帝君为何依旧镇定自若、毫无惧色？
他实在按捺不住，拱手忐忑问道：“帝君，三大域顶尖势力联军压境，兵锋滔天，您……您当真无需担忧半分吗？”
莫凡抬眼，朗声长笑，笑声坦荡霸气，震得周遭虚空微颤：“担忧？若担忧便能退敌、能定乾坤，那我辈修士磨砺一身胆气、修得无上战力，又有何用？”
他眸光锐利，俯瞰四方，底气磅礴浩荡：“朕正愁万古帝朝师出无名，缺一个正大光明开疆拓土、威震万域的契机。”
“既然这几大势力迫不及待送上门来，想要瓜分我青龙域，那朕便顺势接下！
此番，朕便借他们之手，彻底铺平我万古帝朝的开疆之路！”
区区三域联军，在如今底蕴滔天、手握空冥世界的莫凡眼中，根本不足为惧，反倒成了送上门的机缘与战功！
莫凡如今修为早已今非昔比，自身战力足以正面抗衡高阶大圣，再加上空冥世界所化的无上神国坐镇疆域，所谓三大域联军来犯，在绝对主场优势之下，注定只能是有来无回。
更关键的是，此番压境的三域联军之中，早已埋下了他亲手安插的暗棋。
手握内应、坐拥天险、身负盖世修为，三重底气加持，他自然无半分顾虑。
“小黄的妖网情报总能先人一步，是妖网如今的情报脉络已然遍布万域、效率滔天，还是某些人并未在意？”
莫凡眉头微蹙，心底暗自沉吟。
“雷霆，你可千万莫要让朕失望。”
压下心底思绪，他抬手示意牛三古继续禀报。
牛三古不敢拖沓，道出了第三桩秘闻，此事，竟关乎青儿。
如今的青儿，在天域乃至整个灵界的名头，早已隐隐盖过了莫凡，凶名赫赫、无人不晓。

数月之前，青儿孤身踏入天域，杀伐果断，强势覆灭了一族依附天宫的古老氏族，更是亲手斩落了该族万年一遇的绝世天骄。
那位天骄位列天骄榜前二十，天资卓绝、底蕴深厚，早已被天宫内定为预备客卿，前途无量。
可这般前途斐然的顶尖天才，却骤然陨落于青儿剑下，无异于当众打了天宫的脸面，彻底触怒了这座天域至尊势力。
震怒之下，天宫当即出动数名中阶大圣，更有一位高阶大圣亲自带队，跨域追杀青儿，不死不休。
一路血战、一路逃亡，青儿也因此被天域冠以“赤魔旱魃”的凶名，形象被彻底妖魔化，赫然登上天宫穷凶极恶榜单，成了诸天公认的邪魔异类。
“好一个天宫！”
听闻全程始末，莫凡双目骤然凝寒，指节死死攥紧，双拳咔咔作响，周身空气瞬间凝滞，脸色阴沉得如同覆上一层寒霜。
一旁的牛三古感知到这股滔天怒意，连忙垂首屏息，大气不敢出，生怕触怒盛怒之下的帝君。
“青儿素来沉稳，此番不惜公然挑衅天宫、屠戮依附古族，定然是为了替我转移阎家视线，以身引开所有暗处杀机！”
莫凡齿间发紧，心底又怒又涩，满心不甘与憋屈。
content_en:
Niu Sangu, who was on the side, felt anxious when he heard this. Seeing that the emperor still looked calm and calm, he couldn't help but feel confused, and his heart was filled with confusion.
In his eyes, this moment is already an imminent crisis of destruction!
In the past, only the four major alien tribes in Kunxie Mountain were involved in rebellion, which was enough to stir up turmoil among the entire Qinglong Territory human race, leading to continuous battles and countless casualties.
Now, the top overlords from the three major territories of Beishan, Fire, and Wood have joined forces to invade. The strength and terrifying combat power of the coalition forces are definitely not comparable to the alien rebellions of the past.
With such a huge enemy pressing down on the territory, why did the emperor remain calm and unafraid?
He couldn't hold it back any longer, so he raised his hands and asked anxiously: "Emperor, the top forces from the three major domains have joined forces to press the border, and the force is overwhelming. You...you really don't need to worry at all?"
Mo Fan raised his eyes and laughed loudly, his laughter was so magnanimous and domineering that it made the surrounding space tremble slightly: "Worried? If worrying can defeat the enemy and settle the world, then what's the use of our cultivators honing their courage and cultivating supreme combat power?"
His eyes were sharp, overlooking the four directions, and his confidence was majestic and mighty: "I am worried that the emperor's disciples from all ages have no name, and lack an opportunity to open up the territory and expand the territory in an upright and open manner, and to be powerful in all regions."
"Since these major forces can't wait to come to our door and want to carve up my Azure Dragon Territory, then I will take over!
This time, I will use their hands to completely pave the way for the expansion of our eternal imperial dynasty! "
In the eyes of Mo Fan, who now has a huge wealth of knowledge and holds the world of the sky and the underworld, the mere three-region coalition is nothing to be afraid of. Instead, it has become an opportunity and meritorious service!
Mo Fan's cultivation is now different from what it used to be. His own combat power is enough to compete with the high-level saints head-on. In addition, the Supreme Divine Kingdom transformed from the Kongming World is located in the territory. The so-called invasion of the three major domain coalition forces is destined to come and go without any return due to the absolute home field advantage.
What's more important is that among the three-domain coalition forces that are pressing the border this time, he has already laid a secret plan that he personally planted.
With internal support in hand, natural dangers in hand, unparalleled cultivation, and the blessing of three layers of confidence, he naturally has no worries.
"Xiao Huang's demon network intelligence is always one step ahead of others. Is it because the demon network's intelligence network has spread all over the world and is extremely efficient, or do some people just not care?"
Mo Fan frowned slightly, thinking secretly in his heart.
"Thunder, you must never let me down."
Suppressing his thoughts, he raised his hand to signal Niu Sangu to continue reporting.
Niu Sangu did not dare to delay and revealed the third secret. This matter actually related to Qing'er.
Today, Qing'er's reputation in the heavenly domain and even the entire spiritual world has already surpassed Mo Fan's, and his reputation is so fierce that everyone knows it.
A few months ago, Qing'er stepped into the Heavenly Realm alone, and with a decisive attack, he powerfully destroyed an ancient clan that relied on the Heavenly Palace, and even personally killed the peerless genius of the clan who only met once in ten thousand years.
That genius is among the top twenty geniuses on the list. He has outstanding talents and profound knowledge. He has already been designated as a reserve guest by the Heavenly Palace and has a bright future.
But such a promising top talent suddenly fell under Qing'er's sword, which was tantamount to publicly slapping Tiangong in the face and completely offending the supreme power in the Tianyu.
In anger, Tiangong immediately dispatched several mid-level great saints, and even a high-level great saint personally led the team to pursue Qing'er across the territory without stopping.
After fighting bloody battles and escaping all the way, Qing'er was nicknamed the "Red Demon Drought Demon" by the heavens. His image was completely demonized, and he suddenly appeared on the list of the most evil in the heavens, becoming a demon recognized by the heavens.
"What a paradise!"
After hearing the whole process, Mo Fan's eyes suddenly became cold, his knuckles were clenched tightly, his fists cracked, the air around him suddenly froze, and his face became gloomy as if covered with a layer of frost.
Niu Sangu, who was on the side, sensed this overwhelming anger and quickly lowered his head and held his breath, not daring to express his anger for fear of offending the furious emperor.
"Qing'er has always been calm, and this time he did not hesitate to openly provoke the Heavenly Palace and massacre the dependent ancient clan. It must be to divert the attention of the Yan family for me and use his body to divert all the murderous intentions from behind!"
Mo FanThe teeth were clenched, and my heart was angry and astringent, full of unwillingness and aggrievedness.
